reason: E2 directly supports that heterogeneous strain fields from lattice distortion contribute to strengthening in MPEAs, but it does not address the specific claim that cold work can isolate this effect from dislocation multiplication or quantify a ~20% increase. E1 is about local chemical ordering in NiCoCr, not heterogeneous lattice strain in FeCoCrNiMn, and thus provides no support for the key premises.
premises: Severe atomic lattice distortion in MPEAs creates heterogeneous strain fields
These heterogeneous strain fields contribute to enhanced mechanical properties via a strengthening mechanism
The strengthening mechanism is distinct from conventional dislocation multiplication effects
Controlled cold work can induce and vary these heterogeneous lattice strain fields in FeCoCrNiMn
The induced strain fields impede dislocation motion, increasing yield strength by ~20%
